existing_exact_apis.preferred_use: Preserve one real failed-attempt or validation-pending candidate workspace without inventing a protected-path mutation incident. The authority dictionary records denial provenance; it grants no productive capability.

existing_exact_apis.implemented_semantics: Strict immutable receipt reads and a stable bounded inventory. Task-attempt lookup survives loss of mutable workspace/index projections and serializes original acquisition against quarantine publication for the same tuple.
existing_exact_apis.limitation: The exact task-attempt lookup does not by itself deny a later attempt ordinal for the same task revision. A new report-only task-revision parking gate is still required. Inventory already has a large finite source bound; choose a smaller admitted supported-profile bound for the new host rather than scanning arbitrary populations.

journal_design_constraints: Proposed new schema: report-only-attempt-disposition-denial@1; kinds parked_failure and candidate_pending_validation. No implementation of this schema is authorized or supplied by this design file.

Derive every task/CID/attempt/workspace/lifecycle fence/source/board/baseline/candidate field from actual original retained objects. Do not accept caller-selected task, candidate, baseline or ordinal inputs.

Keep denial provenance separate from productive authority. Include retry_authorized=False, settlement_authority=False, completion_authority=False, cleanup_allowed=False and acceptance_authority=False; never include private scheduler grants or authentication secrets.

Hash a closed immutable denial body to parking_id. The original current-owner quarantine authority contains that body/parking_id and original state association. Avoid a circular hash that requires knowing the later quarantine timestamp or quarantine_id before publication.

A missing journal does not prove no parking: the new gate must also inspect original strict quarantine inventory for matching new-schema denial provenance. Missing, malformed, changed, conflicting or unreadable inputs fail closed before original pass effects.

Declare bounded journal/quarantine output storage before dispatch. Cancellation/expiry does not mint a new productive lease, extend deadlines, authorize a retry or restore model authority; review deny-only durable closeout against the existing public stopped cleanup contract.
Do not add a second DuckDB open, migration or global connection pool. Any final state bookkeeping must use the original borrowed connection and preserve original attempt/task-CID counts exactly.

A journal that blocks maintenance/selection must be recognized by every supported writer of that state/repository. Unsupported older runtime compositions must refuse activation rather than ignore the new deny path.

proposed_ordering_barriers.barrier: Capture exact original same-host task/state/ordinal/baseline/command/invocation/claims/lifecycle and registered source-defined finalizers before fallible observations. Keep the original borrowed connection, root/phase, output descriptors and custody objects alive.

Independently observe original stopped Git/provider/watchdog custody, consumer drain and public owner closeout. On any uncertainty retain all actual references and perform no task/claim/lifecycle disposition, retry or ordinal rollback.

Publish a DISTINCT bounded deny-only report-only disposition journal in the originally precharged private state area, with no overwrite of conflicting bytes. Fsync journal and parent directory before any new source path allows original scope exit. The original daemon's new earliest gate must read it before maintenance, selection, task-state save, attempt consumption or provider readiness.

Call actual original lifecycle.quarantine_current_owner with the exact retained capture and a closed deny-only authority projection bound to the journal parking identity. Verify its immutable receipt with the original strict reader. If this fails, retain original host/borrow; the already durable journal still denies dispatch.

Drain only authenticated original finalizer continuations inner then outer, at most once, after stopped proof. Record actual outcomes separately: absent; unchanged retained genuine fence; replaced; unreadable; or partial/unknown. Never unlink a replacement and never treat release True as absence. Failed continuation blocks automatic scope exit.

Re-read journal, original immutable quarantine and original state/counter projection using the same caller-owned usable borrowed connection. A separate reviewed parked-closeout API may unregister borrowing only after durable denial, preserved lifecycle, all physical custody stopped and exact original finalizers complete. The existing disposition_pending latch stays monotonic; it is never cleared merely to pass an old guard.

Candidate input remains inert under quarantine and deny gate. Any independent validation uses a separately reviewed admitted read/copy and validator contract; journal or quarantine JSON grants no permission to mutate, reuse evidence, merge, complete a task or invoke another provider.

why_current_observations_do_not_settle_d: Native stopped proof authenticates the original physical processes/containers/consumers. It does not transfer the original task claim, lifecycle, candidate, state row or caller connection.

The original task-claim release returns True while deliberately retaining a genuine protected-path fence claim. False can mean absence, replacement or refusal. The resource batch release catches per-claim errors and returns False; the unchanged original finally does not use that return value.

Original finally continuations are at most once. A successful callback only proves that original source body ran; a failed callback may already have released some claims and must not be replayed blindly.
A protected-path active snapshot may be cleared by unchanged crash reconciliation. A same-process task claim may be reusable. Neither is an indefinite report-only no-retry parking contract.

The original common ephemeral completion tail is bypassed by the candidate-only return. Clearing active state or terminalizing/deleting its lifecycle requires an explicit parking or ownership-transfer result.
Provider returncode zero, a candidate commit, syntax validity and a portable JSON record do not establish native validation, legal fidelity, supported logic families or Lean4 build correctness.
